name: content-engine
description: Develop creative direction and deliver editable source-linked editions alongside existing content and search workflows.

interface.longDescription: Bring an owned essay, interview or idea. Develop the story and voice, compare creative treatments, produce an original piece and distinct channel drafts, then export editable work with source and revision checks. Includes existing content creation and search workflows. The host model writes and judges the work; Python checks exact source spans and delivers a local archive. The signature-edition workflow needs no account or connected MCP server. Connector examples are opt-in. Media rendering, publishing and customer acceptance require separate evidence.
defaultPrompt: Turn this owned source into a distinctive, editable edition.
Compare three creative treatments, then finish the strongest draft.
